methodology: Production builds, public SDK. Rotated renderer order. New terminal per case/repetition; 9 different cold needles and 24 same-needle navigations. all-count validates exact totals on both paths; upstream xterm additionally creates offscreen/onscreen decorations while native selects one match. next-only is xterm without full count; native always returns all counts. Timing stops at API completion, not GPU/display completion. Text selection and counts validated outside timed region. Unicode/cell wrap fixture is not a glyph-conformance claim. Native worker round trip included. Browser timer resolution applies. No concurrent benchmark.
